question: How long was the Second Great War in StarCraft Lore (in years, rounded up)

4.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the current Blizzard canon the conflict that is called the Second Great War / the Terran-Dominion vs. Kerrigan’s Swarm war is the StarCraft II war.

It is set up in the 2504 Wings of Liberty prologue and it runs through the Heart of the Swarm campaign in ~2505-2506 and is generally closed out with the end of the Dominion/Zerg confrontation in ~2507. 
In calendar terms that is the three calendar years 2504-2507, i.e. about 3 y 6 m of in-universe time, about three years of effective fighting.

Rounded up that is the ~4 calendar years 2504, 2505, 2506, 2507 that are usually quoted as “~3 years, ~4 years rounded”.  That is the commonly cited ~3 year Second Great War, ≈4 years on an inclusive/rounded-up count.

PUBLIC RESPONSE: In Koprulu canon the “Second Great War” is the Brood War that follows the end of the Umojan-Terran / Zerg First Great War.

In the published chronology the fighting that is called the Second Great War / Brood War opens with the breakup of the Overmind and Kerrigan’s re-emergence as the Queen of Blades in c. 2504 and is conventionally closed with the Battle of Char and the collapse of the main Zerg threat in c. 2508-2509. 

That is about 4 yr ± a few months of active interstellar campaigning, i.e. ~4.3-4.8 yr in the books / novels, which is normally quoted as a four-year-plus war. Rounded up to whole years the war is quoted as a ≈ 5 year conflict, the four-year-to-five-year Brood War window 2504-2509 that is usually rendered in trivia as a ~5 year Second Great War.

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In-universe the conflict that Blizzard / the Field Manual refers to as the Second Terran-Zerg / Second Great War is the Kerrigan-led Zerg war against the Dominion/Protoss that opens StarCraft II and runs through Legacy of the Void.

In-universe dating it is conventionally dated from the re-emergence of the Queen of Blades and the opening Terran Dominion campaign on Korhal in ~2504 with Wings of Liberty, through Heart of the Swarm in ~2505-2506, to the final defeat of Amon and the end of the War of the Void in ~2507. 

That is ~3.0-3.5 in-universe years of continuous great-power war, about three calendar years of open fighting. Ceiled to whole years that is ~4 years of Second Great War. The commonly quoted 2504 → 2507 span is ~3 years nominal, ~3½ years actual, i.e. 4 years rounded up.

PUBLIC RESPONSE: The “Second Great War” that is normally quoted in the Koprulu canon is the Terran Dominion / Swarm Great War of StarCraft II, i.e. the conflict that follows the Dominion’s rise and Kerrigan’s reign as Queen of Blades.

In the official chronology it is placed

* c. late 2504 – the opening Zerg offensives that coincide with the start of Wings of Liberty and the Raynor’s Raiders rebellion, and

If the fractional part is dropped the canon shorthand is the ~3-year war, 2504-2507.

In-universe chronology the war is placed

* start ≈ 2504, the Dominion’s post-Brood War crackdown and the first Zerg counter-offensives that open Wings of Liberty
* close ≈ late 2505, the Battle of Char / the evacuation of Kerrigan and the withdrawal of the Swarm that closes the Wings of Liberty campaign

That is on the order of ~12-18 months of in-universe fighting, i.e. about one calendar year of active operations.  Put on a whole-year ceiling the span 2504 → 2505 is conventionally quoted as a 1-yr war, ≈ 2 yr when years are rounded up and counted inclusively.

The Second Great War is best treated as the major StarCraft II conflict: it opens with the renewed hostilities around Char in 2504 during *Wings of Liberty* and runs through the final campaign against Amon in 2506. The span from 2504 to 2506 is about two years, and since the question asks for years rounded up, it stays 2.

8.text:
In the Koprulu canon the war that is normally referred to as the Second Great War is the Terran–Zerg Brood War that follows the First Terran–Zerg War and the fall of the Terran Confederacy.

In the published chronology the war is placed in the 2503/2504–2505/2506 window.

* the Dominion is proclaimed and Kerrigan is re-established as the Queen of Blades in 2504, the Zerg offensive against Korhal and the rest of the sector opening that year;
* the campaign culminates with the assault on Char and the death of the Overmind in late 2504/early 2505 and the subsequent fragmentation of the Zerg Broods.

That is ≈ 1½–2 yr of in-universe real time, i.e. two calendar years 2504-2505, 2503-2505 inclusive.  Counted inclusively / rounded up it is the three calendar years 2503-2505 that are normally quoted for the Brood War/Second Great War, ~2 yr of actual elapsed time.

10.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: 2 years. The Second Great War is best framed from the renewed Zerg invasion and Dominion crisis beginning in 2504 through the conclusion of Kerrigan’s campaign against Mengsk in 2505. That spans parts of two campaign years and, rounded up, gives 2. The later Amon/End War events are usually treated as a separate conflict, so I wouldn’t extend the count into 2506.

1.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The discussion shows a definitional split over what Blizzard calls the “Second Great War”.

* Brood War / StarCraft I expansion camp: Colleagues 1 and 8 treat the Second Great War as the Brood War that follows the First Terran-Zerg War. Colleague 1 dates it c.2504 breakup of Overmind/Kerrigan re-emergence → c.2508-2509 Battle of Char, ~4.3-4.8 yr, rounded up ~5 yr. Colleague 8 dates it 2503/2504-2505/2506, ~1.5-2 yr real time, two calendar years 2504-2505, inclusively three calendar years 2503-2505. That is the classic Brood War interpretation, but dates/span are inconsistent between colleagues.

* StarCraft II = Second Great War camp: Colleagues 2,4,6 treat the Second Great War as the Dominion/Zerg/Protoss conflict of StarCraft II, i.e. Wings of Liberty → Heart of the Swarm → Legacy of the Void. Consensus dates: start c.late 2504 opening Dominion/Swarm hostilities, end c.2506-2508 with Battle of Char / end of Heart of the Swarm / War of the Void. Elapsed time quoted as ~3.0-3.8 yr, nominal 2504→2507, i.e. ~3 yr 6 mo. Rounded up to whole years that is commonly given as ~4 yr. Colleague 5 gives a similar 2504→2506-2507 span ~2.5-3.5 yr, rounded up ~3 yr.

* Short 2504-2505 Dominion vs Kerrigan camp: Colleagues 3,7,9,10 limit the Second Great War to the opening Wings of Liberty / Heart of the Swarm phase, roughly late 2504 → mid/late 2505, ~12-18 mo ≈1.3-1.5 yr real time. Rounded up that is 2 yr; with inclusive counting some quote 1 yr active, 2 yr ceiling. Colleague 10 explicitly excludes Amon/End War as a separate conflict.

Unresolved points: canonical naming is contested. If the official Second Great War is the Brood War, elapsed time is on the order of ~1-2 yr, ceiling 2 yr, with some colleagues stretching the window to ~4-5 yr and mixing in StarCraft II events. If the official Second Great War is the StarCraft II era, elapsed time is ~3-3.5 yr, ceiling 4 yr, with a narrower 2504-2505 reading giving ceiling 2 yr.

I am keeping both date ranges and the mapping of names to games, noting the overlap/confusion between Brood War dates 2503-2505 and StarCraft II start 2504, and the impact of inclusive vs elapsed counting and rounding up. Need a canonical source for the exact Blizzard label and precise in-universe dates before committing.

2.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The deliberation is split on what entity is actually called the “Second Great War” in Koprulu canon, and that definitional split drives all the date / length disagreements.

Definition camps:
* Brood War camp. Colleagues 1,8,9 treat Second Great War as the Brood War / post-Overmind Kerrigan war that follows the First Terran-Zerg Great War. Dating proposed ~2504 start with Overmind death / Kerrigan’s re-emergence as Queen of Blades, close late 2504/early 2505 with the Battle of Char / fragmentation of the Zerg. Reported elapsed time ~1.5-2 yr real time, ~2 calendar years 2504-2505, inclusive 2503-2505. Rounded up that is normally quoted as 2 yr, with an inclusive calendar count of 3 yr.
* StarCraft II war camp. Colleagues 2,4,5,6,7 treat Second Great War as the Terran Dominion / Raynor vs Kerrigan Swarm war played out in StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty → Heart of the Swarm → Legacy of the Void. Dating proposed ~late 2504 start with Wings of Liberty prologue / Korhal, through ~2505-2506 Heart of the Swarm to ~2507 close with Amon / War of the Void / Battle of Char / Aiur. Reported elapsed ~3.0-3.5 yr real time, ~3 calendar years 2504-2507. Ceiled to whole years that is quoted as ~4 yr, with shorthand “about three years”.

Evidence and tensions:
* Colleague 1 claims a 2504-2508/2509 closure and ~4.3-4.8 yr ≈5 yr rounded up. That implies a very long Brood War window; 2508-2509 for Battle of Char is inconsistent with canon Brood War chronology, suggesting conflation with StarCraft II / Legacy of the Void events.
* Colleagues 3,10,9 push for a tight 2504-2505 Dominion/Swarm window ~12-18 months, rounded up to 2 yr inclusive, and explicitly separate later Amon/End War events.
* Colleagues 2,4,6 give a consistent 2504→2507 span ~3 yr 6 mo, quoted as ~4 yr rounded up, and cite Blizzard/Field Manual naming of the SCII conflict as Second Terran-Zerg / Second Great War.
* Colleague 7 and 8 note inclusive/year-counting effects: actual elapsed ~1.5-2 yr can become 2-3 calendar years when counted inclusively.

Open issues / uncertainty:
* Which naming is authoritative in Blizzard canon: Brood War = Second Great War vs StarCraft II trilogy = Second Great War? The dialogue uses both.
* Precise in-universe start/stop months for Overmind death, Battle of Char, Wings of Liberty prologue, Heart of the Swarm, Legacy of the Void.
* Whether “rounded up” means ceil of fractional years of elapsed time or inclusive calendar-year count. Both usages appear.

Current working understanding: canonically the Brood War is widely referred to as the Second Great War and is ~1.5-2 yr real time, i.e. 2 yr rounded up, 3 yr inclusive. If the Second Great War is taken to mean the StarCraft II Dominion/Swarm/Protoss war, the elapsed time is ~3-3.5 yr, i.e. ~4 yr rounded up. The naming ambiguity remains the key unresolved blocker.

Definition A – Second Great War = the Brood War / post-Overmind Terran-Zerg war:
* Colleague 1, 8 treat it as the Brood War that follows the First Terran-Zerg / Umojan-Terran First Great War, opening with the breakup of the Overmind/Kerrigan’s re-emergence c.2504 and closing with the Battle of Char / collapse of the main Zerg threat c.2505/2508-2509. They quote ~4.3-4.8 yr active campaigning, ~5 yr rounded up, and an alternative ~1.5-2 yr in-universe real time, i.e. two calendar years 2504-2505, three calendar years inclusive.
* Colleague 3, 9, 10, 7, 8 further narrow it to the Dominion/Zerg phase opened by Kerrigan’s resurgence in late 2504 and closed with Kerrigan’s capture / the Battle of Char / evacuation in 2505-2506. That is ~12-18 months ~1.3-1.5 yr actual, ~2 yr rounded up / inclusive.

Definition B – Second Great War = the StarCraft II trilogy war, i.e. the Terran Dominion / Raynor vs Kerrigan Swarm and later Protoss-Zerg coalition war:
* Colleague 2, 4, 5, 6 treat the name as the StarCraft II conflict, conventionally dated from the re-emergence of the Queen of Blades / Wings of Liberty prologue c. late 2504 through Heart of the Swarm c. 2505-2506 to the end of the War of the Void / Legacy of the Void c. 2507-2508.
* Duration estimates cluster around ~3.0-3.8 in-universe years, i.e. the calendar span 2504→2507. Colleague 2,4,6 cite ~3y6m, ~3y-3y8m, ceiling to ~4 years whole-year rounded up. Colleague 5 quotes ~2½-3½ yr, ~3 yr rounded up.
* Colleague 7 gives a shorter 2504-2506 framing, ~2 yr rounded up.

Important evidence noted: official chronology places Wings of Liberty in 2504, Heart of the Swarm in 2505-2506, Legacy of the Void in 2507; Brood War events are clustered 2504-2505. The terminology is inconsistent across sources/fans: “Brood War” is often colloquially called the Second Great War, while post-2010 Blizzard material often refers to the StarCraft II era as the Second Great War / Great War.

Current leaning: the more widely cited recent canon usage aligns Second Great War with the StarCraft II era 2504-2507, giving ~3-3.5 yr actual → 4 yr rounded up; the Brood-War definition remains a live competing interpretation yielding ~2 yr rounded up.

* c. late 2504 / early 2505 – Battle of Char, collapse of the main Zerg threat and fragmentation of the broods

The naming is the whole problem.

If the term is taken in the classic pre-2010 usage, *Second Great War = Brood War*. That is the Terran / Protoss vs Zerg war that opens with the fracture of the Overmind and Kerrigan’s re-establishment as the Queen of Blades in c. late 2504 and closes with the Battle of Char and the effective collapse of the main Zerg threat in c. early-mid 2505. In-universe elapsed time is ~12-18 months of open interstellar campaigning, i.e. parts of two calendar years 2504-2505. On a whole-year ceiling that is conventionally quoted as a ~1-2 yr war, 2 yr rounded up inclusive.

That is the definition Colleague 1, 8, 10, 3, 9 are using, and it is the one the original StarCraft field manual and the Brood War chronology explicitly label the Second Great War.

The post-2010 Blizzard material, and the StarCraft II chronology that most people now quote, however, uses Second Great War / Second Terran-Zerg Great War for the StarCraft II trilogy conflict. On the official chronology that is:

* c. late 2504 – Wings of Liberty prologue, re-emergence of Kerrigan and renewed Dominion-Swarm hostilities;
* c. 2505-2506 – Heart of the Swarm;
* c. 2507 – Legacy of the Void / War of the Void, defeat of Amon.

If the classic Brood War definition is insisted on, the same ceiling rule gives ~1.5 yr actual → 2 yr rounded up inclusive, 2504-2505.
